model.title: Moab UMTRA Project Transition Act of 2025
model.meta: Energy and Natural Resources Committee · Sen. John Curtis (R-UT)

summary.text: The bill would allow the Department of Energy to transfer a uranium milling site near Moab, Utah, to Grand County at no cost once cleanup of radioactive waste is complete. The transfer would include restrictions preventing the county from later selling or giving any part of the land to private parties or nonprofits, and the Department of Energy would retain rights to water and well access needed for ongoing groundwater cleanup.
